nodes.norm_label: ci quality gate job (typecheck, build, test)

nodes.label: Monorepo Structure with pnpm Workspaces
nodes.rationale: Monorepo keeps database schemas, validation types, and shared domain models closely aligned while keeping frontend and backend dependencies cleanly separated.

nodes.label: Dist Asset Bundling Verification Step
nodes.rationale: TypeScript compiler tsc does not emit raw JSON translation assets or SQL migration files into dist/, so CI step explicitly asserts their presence to prevent broken builds in production.

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Logs & Session Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Append-only audit_logs table records every critical admin action; server-side logout deletes tokens immediately from SQLite.

nodes.label: CBE SMS Matching Decision Support
nodes.rationale: Forwarded SMS is spoofable; matching provides 1-tap evidence enrichment while keeping final fulfillment decision in administrator hands.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Production Configuration
nodes.rationale: With NODE_ENV=production, boot fails unless ADMIN_PASSWORD, WALLET_PAY_MODE=live, and WALLET_PAY_API_KEY are configured, preventing mock payments from auto-confirming real orders.

nodes.label: Order State Machine Invariants
nodes.rationale: updateOrderStatus validates against an explicit transition map (ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS) to prevent regressions (e.g. pending_approval dropping to awaiting_payment), protecting uploaded receipts.

nodes.label: RBAC Permission Matrix & Auto-Backfill
nodes.rationale: Least-privilege scoping across superadmin, ops, finance, support roles with automatic backward-compatible backfill from ADMIN_IDS.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Referral Double-Entry Ledger
nodes.rationale: Commissions are ledger entries with unique idempotency keys credited only on fulfilled on NET revenue, preventing double payouts.

nodes.label: Server-Side Pricing Authority
nodes.rationale: All order prices are resolved exclusively by pricing.service.ts; client-supplied prices and callback amounts are never trusted to prevent payment bypass exploits.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL Mode & Persistence Strategy
nodes.rationale: Synchronous SQLite operations via better-sqlite3 provide high throughput, zero external database operational overhead for VPS deployment, and ACID transaction guarantees.

nodes.label: Wallet Pay Webhook Trust Model
nodes.rationale: Canonical HMAC-SHA256 signature scheme, ±5min timestamp freshness window, and mandatory paid amount/currency verification against stored quote before fulfillment.

nodes.label: Roadmap Phase C: PostgreSQL Migration Strategy
nodes.norm_label: roadmap phase c: postgresql migration strategy
nodes.rationale: SQLite is single-writer per file; horizontal cross-region scaling requires database consolidation to PostgreSQL with async repositories.

nodes.label: Finding A4: CoinGecko Cache Stampede & Single-Flight Cache
nodes.norm_label: finding a4: coingecko cache stampede & single-flight cache
nodes.rationale: Single-flight promise coalescing prevents thundering herds from bombarding CoinGecko API on cache expiry.

nodes.label: Finding A8: Database-Backed Leader Lease for Multi-Process Scale
nodes.norm_label: finding a8: database-backed leader lease for multi-process scale
nodes.rationale: job_leases table ensures only one designated worker handles Telegram polling and background sweepers in multi-process deployments.

nodes.label: Finding A5/A7: Missing Outbound Timeouts & Circuit Breaker
nodes.norm_label: finding a5/a7: missing outbound timeouts & circuit breaker
nodes.rationale: Hardened HTTP client with 8s timeouts, retry with jitter, and circuit breaker prevents upstream payment gateway hangs from exhausting Node sockets.

nodes.label: Finding A1: Synchronous SQLite Event Loop Blocking
nodes.norm_label: finding a1: synchronous sqlite event loop blocking
nodes.rationale: Prepared statement cache, 250ms busy timeout, and withWriteRetry unblock high-concurrency event loop.

nodes.label: Finding A6: Unbounded Payment Reconciliation Sweeper
nodes.norm_label: finding a6: unbounded payment reconciliation sweeper
nodes.rationale: Bounding queries with LIMIT 100 and single-flight lock prevents database lock starvation.

nodes.label: Finding A3: Uncached N+1 Mini App Bootstrap Reads
nodes.norm_label: finding a3: uncached n+1 mini app bootstrap reads
nodes.rationale: 20s catalog cache and batched DB queries eliminate N+1 round trips during Mini App launch.
